description: This file is a React component for managing agents, including listing, adding, deleting, and viewing detailed info about agents within a dashboard or admin interface.

methods.name: fetchAgents
methods.description: Fetches the list of agents from the server and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleAddAgent
methods.description: Prepares and shows the form modal to add a new agent.

methods.name: handleCloseModal
methods.description: Closes the add agent form modal.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes the agent list after adding a new agent successfully.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Sets the selected agent to be deleted, prompting the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Performs the delete operation for the selected agent.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation, resetting the delete state.
